annotations.title: Get a Pension Fund's Reviewed Holdings

description: One reviewed public pension fund in What Your Pension Owns, a MORVS register built from the SEC's quarterly Form 13F data sets (Q3 2025 to Q2 2026 at launch) and five funds' own holdings reports, matched issuer by reviewed issuer to the Pentagon's Section 1260H list, Treasury's NS-CMIC list, DHS's UFLPA Entity List and two MORVS registers (the Detention Ledger's publicly traded operators, and the listed parents of vendors counted in Who Gets Your Data's government lane), found by fund (its name as the register prints it or as filed, a two-letter state, or a 10-digit SEC CIK; when several match, each in short form with the arguments that return its full profile). Returns the fund's profile (state, type and its label, the basis for counting it as a public pension fund, CIK, legal name as filed and SEC filer link, and its own holdings report where the register reads one, with its as-of date, unit and scope), its Form 13F filing for each quarter (accession, amendments, table entries and value as filed), its figures by list, source and date and up to 25 matched positions (shares and debt apart, with each list's date and the designation-after-holding flag), the register's quarter-to-quarter changes for the fund (positions added and exited per list between quarters it filed, with the values on each date side by side, never subtracted), and, for each list where it holds no reviewed match, the counter-finding with the quarters and report read. The two sources are never added together, and no total adds two lists, two dates, two reports, or shares and debt; a company on two lists appears under each. A holding is a position a fund reported on a stated date: it does not show why the fund held it, whether it followed an index, or what the fund holds today. A designation dated after a holding is flagged on that position (designation_postdates_holding) and its value is kept apart from holdings on the list at the holding date. The MORVS registers are not government designations. No state divestment law is applied. Answers are kept under about 25 KB. The answer carries as_of, retrieved, the file dates, the question, list, index, coverage and law notes, the claim rules, the licence and the source page on morvs.ai; an empty result carries the register's absence note (no reviewed match in that fund's filing or report for that date, which is not a statement about other dates, other accounts or holdings through outside funds). Pension funds are institutions; no person is named.

fund.description: Required reviewed fund name (as printed or as filed), a two-letter state, or a 10-digit SEC CIK, for example CalSTRS, TX or 0000810265.
